text:
The doctor and staff provided excellent service.

At first, I thought using my government health insurance would lead to a negative experience, but my first visit was surprisingly impressive. They offered a free full-mouth X-ray. The doctor was very polite, gave good advice, and seemed genuinely dedicated to their profession. They also provided helpful recommendations based on the X-ray results, not just a superficial review.

Furthermore, after the procedure, the staff provided a clear and helpful summary for the patient.

I highly recommend this clinic.
